visual_review: Front view: tapered canopy over the body, one central headlight above the centre front wheel, and two rear wheels outboard of the body; mirrored on x24, reads as a three-wheeler/tuk-tuk at 48.
omissions: Two headlights reduced to one central lamp (two dots read as a face); canopy lip line and outlined tyre pills dropped for 8-unit spacing.
